title: Sony BRAVIA 4K GB (BRAVIA_ATV2_UC, MediaTek mt5891), US/Canada firmware
header:
Sony BRAVIA 4K GB (BRAVIA_ATV2_UC, MediaTek mt5891), US/Canada firmware
Android TV 9, build PTT1.190515.001.S54 672201, security patch 2022-01-05
Same platform and build as examples/sony-xbr-x900e; this list confirms it on a second model.

Apply:   TV_HOST=<tv ip> tools/disable.sh examples/sony-bravia-4k-gb-us/debloat.txt
Undo:    TV_HOST=<tv ip> tools/restore.sh examples/sony-bravia-4k-gb-us/debloat.txt
Everything is DISABLED, not uninstalled. Comment out any line you want to keep.

Stock launcher: com.google.android.tvlauncher (restore.sh's default).
Live TV / input app: com.sony.dtv.tvx. Keep it: it also plays every HDMI input.
Keep: com.sony.dtv.tvinput.*, braviasync* (HDMI-CEC), remotepairing, rcpowerkey, uinputservice,
imeproxy, sonysystemservice, settingsprovider, all com.mediatek.* and mtktvapi.agent.
Already disabled at the factory: com.sony.dtv.actionmenu.plugin.harmony. Not in this list.

Notes from this firmware:
- ADB: the Developer options switch is labelled "ADB debugging", not "USB debugging". Port 5555
stays closed until it is on.
- com.google.android.tungsten.setupwraith is installed but did not take Home: build-and-install.ps1
landed Home on com.gathin.tvhome first time with only com.google.android.tvlauncher disabled.
Hide com.sony.dtv.tvx and com.sony.dtv.tvxlauncher.programguide in config.xml and leave
live_tv_package empty if you have no antenna; Inputs lists HDMI 1-4 (with CEC names) and Video 1/2.
- The stock launcher's "Free Live TV" / "Top Selling" rows and the top banner come from
tvlauncher itself and stay until it is replaced.
- Tested the same day it was applied: Home, the Input menu, HDMI inputs and the new launcher all
work. Not yet lived with for several days, and not yet tested across a reboot.
